What Prime Intellect sells

Provides computing resources and tools for teams that train and run their own AI systems.

  • Lab · A platform for reinforcement learning (models learn by trying tasks and receiving scores) and further model training.
  • Environment Hub · Environments for model training and evaluation.
  • Verifiers
  • Prime-RL
  • Prime Inference Gateway
  • Sandboxes · Isolated environments for training and evaluation.
